markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 宾语从句就是**把一整句话塞进另一句话里**，放在 think、know、say、wonder 这些词后面，当它们说的「内容」。塞进去以后，这句话要**像平常说话那样排**，不再倒过来。

uses.en: I think [[that]] it's a good idea.
Can you tell me [[what time]] it starts?
uses.en_zh: 你能告诉我几点开始吗？

that.title: 说内容：that
that.rule: 说「我觉得、我知道、他说」的内容，用 that 接一整句话。口语里 that **常常省掉**，意思不变。

examples.en: I hope [[that]] the demo goes well.

notes: 省掉 that 也完全可以：I think it's a bug.（我觉得这是个 bug。）
说「我觉得不会」，英语习惯把 not 放前面：I [[don't think]] it'll work. 比 I think it won't work 自然。

if.title: 是不是：if / whether
if.rule: 原来是个 **yes / no 问题**，塞进句子时用 if 或 whether，意思是「**是不是**」。后面变回正常语序。

examples.en: I don't know [[if]] it's ready yet.
Can you check [[whether]] the server is up?
examples.zh: 你能看看服务器是不是正常吗？

examples.en: I wonder [[if]] she got my email.
examples.zh: 不知道她收到我的邮件没有。

wh.title: 问什么：what / where…
formula: Do you know / Can you tell me…
wh.rule: 疑问词留下，后面**变回正常说话的顺序**：主语在前，动词在后，**不要** do / does / did。

examples.en: Do you know [[where]] the meeting room [[is]]?
examples.zh: 你知道会议室在哪儿吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me [[what time]] the train [[leaves]]?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我火车几点开吗？
我不记得我们为什么改了这个。
我不太清楚它是怎么运作的。

wrong.bad: Do you know where ~~is the meeting room~~?
wrong.good: Do you know [[where]] the meeting room [[is]]?

tense.title: 时间跟着往后退
tense.rule: 前面的词是**过去时**（said、thought、knew），后面那句通常也**退一步**变成过去。是一直都对的事，可以不退。
notes: 一直都对的事不用退：Our teacher told us that water [[boils]] at 100 degrees.

this.meaning: 塞进句子里：正常语序，更客气
this.en: Could you tell me where the station [[is]]?

commonMistakes.why: 塞进句子以后用正常语序：主语在前。

commonMistakes.bad: I don't know what ~~does he want~~.
commonMistakes.why: 不要 does，动词跟着主语变。

commonMistakes.bad: Can you tell me where ~~did you buy~~ it?
commonMistakes.good: Can you tell me where you [[bought]] it?
commonMistakes.why: 不要 did，动词直接用过去式。

commonMistakes.bad: I wonder ~~that~~ she got my email.
commonMistakes.good: I wonder [[if]] she got my email.

commonMistakes.why: 英语习惯把 not 放在 think 这边。

quiz.prompt: I'm not sure ___ the build will pass.
I hope ___ the demo goes well.
quiz.explain: 说希望的内容，用 [[that]]（也可以省掉）。

quiz.prompt: 换成更自然的说法：I think it won't work.
accept: I don't think it will work.
I do not think it will work.
I do not think it'll work.
quiz.explain: 把 not 放在 think 这边：I [[don't think]]…

quiz.prompt: 把问题塞进句子：Is it ready? → I don't know …
quiz.answer: I don't know if it's ready.
accept: I don't know whether it's ready.
I don't know if it is ready.
I don't know whether it is ready.
I do not know if it is ready.

traps.input: I don't know if is it ready.
traps.note: if 后面用正常语序：it is ready。

quiz.explain: yes / no 问题用 [[if]]，正常语序：it's ready。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I wonder that she got my email.
quiz.answer: I wonder if she got my email.
accept: I wonder whether she got my email.

quiz.prompt: 把问题塞进句子：Where is the meeting room? → Do you know …
quiz.answer: Do you know where the meeting room is?

traps.input: Do you know where is the meeting room?
traps.note: 塞进句子后用正常语序，is 放到后面。

quiz.prompt: 把问题塞进句子：What time does the train leave? → Can you tell me …
quiz.answer: Can you tell me what time the train leaves?

traps.input: Can you tell me what time does the train leave?
traps.note: 塞进句子后不要 does，说 the train leaves。

quiz.explain: 去掉 does，动词跟着主语变：the train [[leaves]]。
正常语序：why + 主语 + 动词：[[why]] we [[changed]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I don't know what does he want.
quiz.answer: I don't know what he wants.
accept: I do not know what he wants.

quiz.prompt: I thought you ___ (be) on holiday this week.
quiz.explain: 前面 thought 是过去，后面退一步：[[were]]。

quiz.prompt: She said she ___ fix it by Friday.
I didn't know you ___ (have) a dog.
quiz.explain: 前面是过去，后面也用过去：[[had]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Can you tell me where did you buy it?
quiz.answer: Can you tell me where you bought it?
quiz.explain: 不要 did，直接用过去式：you [[bought]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Do you know where is he?
quiz.answer: Do you know where he is?

quiz.prompt: 翻译：你能告诉我车站在哪儿吗？
quiz.answer: Could you tell me where the station is?
accept: Can you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where the station is, please?
Do you know where the station is?

traps.input: Could you tell me where is the station?
traps.note: 塞进句子后用正常语序：the station is。

quiz.explain: 客气地问，用正常语序：where the station [[is]]。

openTask.prompt: 你在一个新城市问路、问事情：写 3 个客气的问题，用 Do you know… / Could you tell me… / I wonder if… 开头。
rules: 塞进句子后的部分用正常语序，主语在前，不用 do / does / did
yes / no 问题用 if 或 whether
openTask.note: 规则判语序和 if / whether（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
